title: Fluffy Vanilla Marshmallows
summary: Soft, airy vanilla marshmallow cubes made with beef gelatine and dusted in icing sugar and cornflour.

ingredients.note: or the equivalent in beef gelatine leaves

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Tin
steps.text: Sift the icing sugar and cornflour together into a bowl. Line the tin with baking paper, brush it with a little oil and sprinkle on a third of the dusting.

steps.title: Bloom
steps.text: Measure the cold water into the mixer bowl, scatter the gelatine over it and set aside for 10 min to soften.

steps.title: Syrup
steps.text: Combine the sugar, corn syrup, water and salt in the saucepan and stir over medium heat until clear. Stop stirring and boil for 7-9 min, until the thermometer shows 116 °C.

steps.title: Whip
steps.text: Start the mixer on low and pour the hot syrup in a thin stream down the inside of the bowl. Switch to high and whip for 10-12 min, adding the vanilla in the last minute. It is ready when it is thick, bright white, about three times the volume and only lukewarm (about 35 °C).

steps.title: Spread
steps.text: Scrape it straight into the tin with the oiled spatula, level the surface and sift over half the remaining dusting.

steps.title: Set
steps.text: Leave uncovered at room temperature for at least 6 h, or overnight. It is set when it springs back and a dry finger comes away clean.

steps.title: Cut
steps.text: Dust a board with the last of the mixture and turn the slab out onto it. Cut into 36 cubes with an oiled knife and roll each cut side in the dusting.

tips: The most common mistake is taking the syrup off below 116 °C; the marshmallows then stay sticky and slump.
Work quickly once whipped; it starts to set within minutes.
Re-oil the knife every few cuts for clean edges.
Toast them over a flame or drop into hot chocolate.
safety: Don't taste the raw dough or batter: raw flour and raw egg aren't safe to eat until baked.
storage: Keep in an airtight box at room temperature for up to 2 weeks; add a little extra dusting if they turn sticky.
